## Checks

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes (if Rust changed)
- [ ] A changed or new promise has its test and its row in `docs/guarantees.md`
- [ ] Breaking changes are listed in `CHANGELOG.md` under "Breaking"
- [ ] Docs that this makes untrue are updated
